keyFindings.description: Regression from the widget change: with S1 registered and claimComplete, a /new to S2 whose re-claim is refused before registering (state() error, 5xx, network) shows the refusal widget and records claimWidget.session = S2; a /resume back to S1 hits the early return at :461-467, handleAgentStart in S1 never clears it (session ids differ), and Oh My Pi's built-in resume does not clear hook widgets (clearHookWidgets only at extension-ui-controller.ts:315/376/588/646 and shutdown). S1, the working controller, shows a lasting warning that wakes do not reach it and set_status fails. Before this round the refusal was a transcript notice in S2. Reproduced by the deep review's scratch unit probe. Fix: clear claimWidget when the session changes to one it was not shown for, before the early return; add the unit test.
